author: Zegita
body:
IGN: Zegita
Person who banned you: Pelpelajax
Why I think this is an error: First of all he banned me for "Please be respectful towards other players" when the only words I said to one person was "Do your fucking job" and I got given no warning nothing and furthermore the fact that I got no warning shows that a mod just bans someone without giving reason first just straight up ban so fix up.
Another thing there was a player hacking and the person who banned me did not believe me I said to him "How about you fight him instead of just spectating and then you'll see" and so I get banned? Basically I got given no warning and mods are supposed to be giving warnings before a ban.

Also, I have been banned before by zacd56 for rudeness only for a day and yet I get banned for 5 days. I have a tournament that I need to attend for my team and I truly believe Pel did a wrong thing. No warning straight up ban this is not right for a mod. All my other bans I have been warned but this no. Furthermore, he's banned me for basically a week which is unfair cuz I didn't even anything that bad. Thank you for reading this

"Zegita or Zeg"

replies.body:
Zegita,

Within the past month, you recieved 6 prior infractions for rudeness, one of them was a previous tempban. You've been given multiple warnings previously and you don't seem to understand following the rules. Therefore, this appeal is denied.

Regards,
Newcleus
Avicus Network Administrator
